class.name: FoxHurtArea3D
class.brief_description: Receives [Variant] payloads from physical interactions and routes them.
class.description: Acts as the receiving end of the Foxbox interaction pipeline. It listens for overlapping [FoxHitArea3D] nodes and broadcasts their payload.

method.name: receive_hit
method.description: Accepts a [Variant] [param payload] from an external source and emits [signal hit_received].

members.member: If [code]false[/code], incoming payloads are silently ignored and no signals are emitted.

signal.name: hit_received
signal.description: Emitted immediately when a [param payload] is successfully delivered to this area.
